summary: Exact: U(p)-D(p) = 2 for every odd prime p=3 mod 4 and 0 for p=1 mod 4 (no p>7 restriction needed). Proof: non-distinct solutions are multisets {u,u,v} with u!=v, i.e. pairs (u,v) with 2/u+1/v=4/p; by the factorisation lemma (fingerprint-0229) there are exactly two such pairs iff p=3 mod 4, both with u!=v: (u,v)=((p+1)/2, p(p+1)/4) and (p(p+1)/2, (p+1)/4). Checked numerically for all 3244 primes 3<=p<=3e4 (scripts/z52d_p2_SK1_isosceles.py, data/z52b/pass2/SK1/Z0833_count4_all_3e4.txt). Consequence: the ordered count O = 6D + 3(U-D) + 0 gives O = 6U-6 at p=3 mod 4 and O = 6U at p=1 mod 4 (all-equal triples are impossible for p>2), so the orbit formula of fingerprint-0266 also follows.
